reason: REJECTED: the operator (jek) determined no shrinkage occurred, after being shown a clause-by-clause comparison of the DONE summary against the original intent snapshot. A confirmed decision would have to withdraw a milestone, checklist item or acceptance binding, and none is being withdrawn - which is itself the proof that this is not shrinkage. Reviewed by the human operator (jek) after being shown a clause-by-clause comparison of the DONE summary against the original intent snapshot. THE DETECTOR FIRED ON WORDING, NOT ON SCOPE. It is a text heuristic over deferral vocabulary, and this story's summary is dense with 'deferred', 'not fixed here' and 'ships unfixed' precisely because its limitations were written honestly; a vaguer summary would not have tripped it. EVERY ELEMENT OF THE ORIGINAL ACCEPTANCE WAS DELIVERED, checked one at a time rather than asserted. normalizedOutcome asked that red_evidence_envelope_check exist and be read-only - it exists, and the read-only property is proven mechanically by a positive git-only spawn allowlist plus a .lattice content-hash manifest that is byte-identical across a batch of direct handler invocations, not asserted; that an inadmissible envelope be rejected with the correct section 1.6 tag - the committed rejection matrix runs 142 fixtures and asserts the TAG, exercising R1-1, R1-2, R1-3, R1-5 and R1-6, with R1-2 and R1-3 never collapsed; and that an admissible envelope report its assertionDigest, matched binding and resolved policyDigest - it does. acceptanceClaim asked that the committed envelope smoke pass covering the schema rules, the three specificity rules, the exact entropy formula, the assertionDigest scope in both directions, the binding check, the tagged rejection matrix and the admissible-envelope success output - the smoke passes with 33 tagged rejection fixtures and all five red-w2d harnesses exit 0, registered in validate.commands rather than passing only by hand. WHAT IS DEFERRED IS NEW WORK, NOT WITHDRAWN WORK. Every deferred item was DISCOVERED during this story and appears nowhere in the original normalizedOutcome or acceptanceClaim: a three-site contradiction in the spec about whether matcher-value bounds apply to class values, where two of the three statements are normative and disagree; the absence of any normative candidate-envelope schema for the very command this story shipped; an inversion in the section 1.3 specificity metric under which SIGSEGV, ENOMEM, HTTP 404 and Error 500 are rejected while the vaguer 'test failed' is admitted, with ENOMEM permanently unpinnable below a non-tunable hard floor; an undocumented canonical-form requirement on the exit class; and a command documented as append-nothing that appends an activity-log row. Each is owned by a real, greppable story - B-595c, B-3654, B-def6, B-1b2b, B-85a7 - every one of which was created only after a reviewer established that an earlier claim of having filed follow-up work was false. NO MILESTONE IS REMOVED and no checklist item or acceptance binding is withdrawn, which is why removedMilestoneIds is empty: nothing the story promised is being retracted. The inversion in particular ships unfixed and is stated as such in limitations, with its measured values pinned by a committed characterization fixture so that a future change to the entropy formula fails mechanically instead of silently moving which failure signatures can be pinned.
